truth_rules: T0 registration is not source publication, rights, or publisher attestation
T3 original tar and T3 host alternative are distinct scopes and must not be added as formal successes
A source-integrated CLI/MCP/SDK gateway or synthetic fixture pass never promotes T4
R9 five tool technical three-phase reviewed cases are not full native CLI/MCP/SDK E2E
Why3 original archive still contains host-unsafe run script, never run privileged
A changed SHA never inherits previous reviewer approval or CI
T5 requires separate source/model/oracle/host and downstream real consumption

As of the 2026-11-17 reconciliation, rows without a pending entry had no new exact-source delta; every merged PR delta is recorded per row as scoped evidence or source identity only, without qualification promotion.
A candidate typed operation in an open PR is not counted as merged CLI/MCP/SDK integration or T4 acceptance.
Portable execution against a Drive core archive is not current-main Runner evidence unless its runner Git Blob matches the exact current main source.
Known tool-specific exit codes must be pinned; EXPECT_*_EXIT=* accepts timeouts and launch failures and is not a safe semantic gate.

Host-substitute and historical portable-core executions remain scoped technical observations; they do not increment original-tar T3 or full T4 counts without the required exact current artifacts and independent review.
